varint_proof: Native result is smallest k in1..4 with no unsigned bits at or above7k, otherwise5. Define b=32-numberOfLeadingZeros(value|1), hence1<=b<=32; result ceil(b/7)=(b+6)/7. Negative values haveb32 and give5. Native native getByteSize performs no IO, mutates no state and throws no input-specific exception. Replaced arithmetic is independent of byte order, buffers and packet lifetime. getByteSize formula derived independently; no third-party code copied.
performance_limit: Removes variable-count branch/mask loop; leadingZeros lowering and division by constant may depend on JIT. No measured CPU/FPS/heap benefit asserted. Typed method avoids extra callback/varargs allocations.
startup_requirements: Mixin must be absent unless astfps.enableVarIntSize=true and safeMode=false; exclude installed Krypton and any known competing VarInt overwrite. Client-side only. No runtime command claims because overwrite installation is startup-only.
